limitations: Historical engineering C domain only, not the new experimental domain.
Fixed physical source nodes; subtract per-node time mean, no moving interpolation.
Regions centered once at each run mean crossing; all 64 windows retained, also inspect both halves.
Temporal residuals contain front motion and physical unsteadiness as well as measurement noise; transition variance is not a pure noise estimate.
Spatial and temporal ACF are descriptive, not fitted confidence intervals or a qualified covariance model.
